Remark
Source: chow-knopf-ricci-flow:page-0054 1. Remark 2.18\group neckpinch

The $s$-derivative and time derivative do not commute; rather, $[\partial _t,\partial _s]=-n(\psi _{ss}/\psi )\partial _s$.
